card.name: Linking words in antihypertensive drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as another, other, both, with, on and commas that sit just before the name of a second blood-pressure drug or drug class. Seen in label text on ARBs, ACE inhibitors and calcium channel blockers.

modes.label: Another/other before a drug class
modes.description: The word another or other comes right before a drug class name in a combination-therapy sentence.
modes.example: alone or with valsartan (or<< another>> ARB) alone may be switched to

modes.label: Comma in a class list
modes.description: A comma separates antihypertensive classes in a list, just before the next class.
modes.example: on any two of the following antihypertensive classes: calcium channel blockers<<,>> angiotensin receptor blockers, and

modes.label: Link before a named drug
modes.description: A short word such as with, on or both comes right before a drug name in an interaction or trial sentence.
modes.example: Do not co-administer aliskiren<< with>> trandolapril tablets in patients

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name another drug or drug class next, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come just before a second blood-pressure drug or drug class is named.
